name: Geologische Übersichtskarte der Bundesrepublik Deutschland 1:250 000 (GÜK250)
provider: BGR - Bundesanstalt für Geowissenschaften und Rohstoffe
licence: Contradictory: BGR General Standard Terms and Conditions https://www.bgr.bund.de/AGB_en (capabilities AccessConstraints) vs GeoNutzV https://sg.geodatenzentrum.de/web_public/gdz/lizenz/geonutzv.pdf (metadata record)
attribution: Datenquelle: GÜK250 (WMS), (c) BGR, Hannover, 2019
notes: LICENCE CONFLICT. The capabilities and the metadata useConstraints point to the BGR AGB/GSTC. GSTC Art. 3(1) says: 'The rights which are not transferred include in particular the right to make accessible to the public'. Art. 3(5) says: 'All other use not expressly specified above, requires special written agreement'. The same CSW record (0f2e1b5b-...) also says the data may be used under GeoNutzV. GeoNutzV §2(1) allows 'kommerzieller und nicht kommerzieller Nutzung'. That is a contradiction, so ask BGR. Technically OK. Server scale limits: Min 1:34,124, Max 1:545,979, so it draws only at about z11-z14; z8 and z10 return empty transparent tiles. Layer 1 = Basislayer_Genese, 2 = Überlagerungslayer_Genese (also 4/5 Petrographie, 7/8 Stratigraphie). 0.2-0.35 s per tile.
